title: Sikky Nissan Z33/G35 Differential Bushing Set
description:
Looking to improve power transfer in your 350z? Replace your old worn out rubber diff bushings with our solid aluminum differential bushings today! These offer much better protection to your half shafts and driveshaft all while improving the wheel hop issues associated with an IRS car. Our 350z solid differential bushings offer the best overall fitment and finish available on the market today.



Features:



CAD/CAM designed CNC T6061 air craft quality Aluminum

Helps eliminate wheel hop

Completely replaces OEM bushings to eliminate sloppy feel

Drastically improves power transfer to the ground

Reduces potential for damage to driveshafts and halfshafts

Eliminates diff movement during launches and clutch kicks
